title: platform_standard
description: A standard we author. The body carries the full text and the know-how; these facets are what a gate and an evaluator read.

standard_id.description: The stable, quotable id: FPS4-SUFF-BASELINE-002. Constant across versions.

tier.description: invariant is never overridable; product may be overridden with a justification and an expiry; guidance is advisory.

assertion.description: The machine-evaluable claim. An evaluator answers it; this service records the verdict and never computes one.

applies_when.description: Predicate over an artifact's facets. Absent means it applies to everything the kind covers.

supports_construct.description: A construct that helps satisfy this cheaply. What makes the standard actionable rather than only enforceable.
